=# III. Where to post feedback=

The {{Link|link= http://dev-heaven.net/projects/oac/boards|text= OAC forum}} is the the best place to share your thoughts and suggestions about the project itself.<br>

{{Feature|important|We cannot follow other forums or news-sites.
So please use our space to get your feedback heard!}}

For bug reporting or suggesting new content to be made compatible the best place is the {{Link|link= http://dev-heaven.net/projects/oac/issues|text= OAC issue tracker}}.
